title: Sustained workflow population panel and isolated costs

population_panel.seed_role: Deterministically shuffle the two independently owned requests; types remain the protocol-declared IEE and SLI frames.
population_panel.inputs: Each actor receives two paid authored workflow intentions over the same bounded task rows and one independently owned workflow_need. No route, face, recipe or expected cell occurs in a request.
population_panel.reporting: For every world report successful native recipe counts mapped to the 32 route-face cells, consecutive equal retained outputs as repeats, stops, episodes, turns, modeled charges and actual types. Repetition is never a new-capacity count.
population_panel.audit: Every raw engine and population checkpoint is independently reconstructed through population_audit without replaying the scheduler, selector or engine. Exact file hashes are retained.

cost_panel.worker_isolation: One fresh Python subprocess per sample on the same interpreter and shared host.
cost_panel.active_work: Two actors, 24-episode declaration, quantum 32 and default repeat limit 2; four successful repeated workflow-selection/native cycles are timed as active work.
cost_panel.downstream_query: One separately timed workflow use-system query consumes a retained output after active timing.

task_count.acceptance: Report observed growth; no unregistered numeric scaling tolerance or constant-time claim.

cost_panel.audit: Cold restore must be byte-exact. The independent population audit and workflow-selection/native audit must pass. Traced workers are excluded from timing medians.

acceptance.worlds: All four sustained worlds finish and independently reconstruct.
acceptance.coverage: A 32-cell table records actual successful counts by world; zero-count cells remain zero.
acceptance.cost: Both shared and unique fixed-active history ratios are at most 3.0, or the batch records failure without tuning the tolerance.
acceptance.tests: New focused tests and unchanged inherited population tests pass; final Phase 6 regression remains separate.
acceptance.source: Executed files match the pre-evaluation freeze. Failed attempts and amendments remain visible.

prohibitions: no route-wide sustained-development claim absent actual coverage
no replenishment, new goals or growing population
